title: Location data sharing
description: Child's device shares live GPS coordinates with the mobile app backend, potentially exposing the child's location to unauthorized parties.
assumptions: Assumes the child's device has location services enabled and is transmitting GPS data at regular intervals.

title: Location data in transit
description: GPS coordinates are transmitted in transit, potentially exposing location data to interception by third parties monitoring the network.
assumptions: Assumes the data is transmitted over a network that could be monitored or intercepted.

title: Location data storage
description: Mobile app backend stores and processes location data, potentially exposing the child's location to unauthorized access or misuse.
assumptions: Assumes the backend has appropriate security controls in place for storing sensitive location data.

title: Unintended data disclosure
description: Mobile app backend may share location data with unauthorized parties or without proper consent, violating the child's privacy expectations.
assumptions: Assumes the backend has appropriate access controls and consent mechanisms for data sharing.

title: Non-compliance with privacy regulations
description: Mobile app backend may not comply with privacy regulations regarding child location data handling, such as COPPA or GDPR-K requirements.
assumptions: Assumes there are applicable privacy regulations for child data that the backend must comply with.

title: Location data may reveal sensitive personal information
description: Location pings collected by the mobile app backend may contain sensitive information about the user's movements, habits, and potentially private locations (e.g., home, workplace, medical facilities) that could be used to infer sensitive personal details about the user.
assumptions: Assumes location data includes precise geolocation coordinates and timestamps

title: Location data can be used to identify individuals
description: Location data collected by the mobile app backend can be used to identify and track specific individuals, potentially enabling profiling and targeted behavior.
assumptions: Assumes location data is linked to user identity

title: Users may not be adequately notified about location tracking
description: Users may not be fully informed about the extent of location data collection and sharing with the location history store, potentially violating transparency requirements.
assumptions: Assumes standard privacy notification practices may not cover all location tracking activities

title: Location history may enable inference of sensitive activities
description: The location history store may retain location data over time, enabling analysis that could reveal sensitive patterns about the user's daily activities, social interactions, and potentially private locations.
assumptions: Assumes location history is retained for extended periods

title: Location data in store can be used for individual identification
description: Location data stored in the location history store can be used to identify and track specific individuals, potentially enabling long-term profiling and identification.
assumptions: Assumes location data is linked to user identity

title: Unintended consequences of location data storage
description: Storing location data may have unintended consequences such as data breaches, unauthorized access, or misuse of location information by third parties.

title: Potential non-compliance with privacy regulations
